controlgroup.description: Group allowed to interact with dhcpcd via the control socket (e.g., 'wheel'). If empty, the line remains commented out.

vendorclassid_value.description: Value for vendorclassid; empty string results in no vendorclassid line being uncommented (i.e., blank/omitted).

slaac_mode.description: SLAAC mode: either 'hwaddr' (using hardware address) or 'private' (stable private IPv6 addresses from DUID). Allowed values are 'hwaddr' and 'private'. (Note: The original file comment mentions 'private' as the default option, though the sample config shows 'private' which aligns with the provided schema.)
